children: Italy raised €8 billion through a new green government bond due in October 2038, the Treasury said on Tuesday, as it continued to tap investor demand for debt earmarked for environmentally sustainable projects.
The new BTP Green, which matures on October 30, 2038, was issued at a re-offer price of 99.591, corresponding to a gross annual yield of 4.492%, the Economy Ministry said in a statement.
The bond carries a 4.40% annual coupon, paid semi-annually, with settlement scheduled for September 29.
